content_of_post_to_answer: Is there anything you can’t control right now that causes anxiety for you?
answer: What makes uncertainty especially exhausting is that the mind often treats an unanswered question as an unfinished responsibility. We keep mentally revisiting situations as if worrying might eventually give us control over them. I've explored this pattern in more depth in other writing on my profile, if you're interested. Sometimes the hardest part isn't accepting that we can't control an outcome; it's accepting that we don't have to keep mentally working on it.
